children: Palm oil inches lower in Asian trading, weighed by weakness overnight in soybean oil prices on the Chicago Board of Trade. However, technical analysis suggests sentiment toward crude palm oil futures is likely to turn neutral to bullish, as the recent bearish trend shows signs of fading, pointing to a cautiously bullish recovery bias, AmInvestment Bank says in a note. It expects CPO futures to find support at 4,187 ringgit a ton and face resistance at 4,296 ringgit a ton. The Bursa Malaysia Derivatives contract for February delivery is 21 ringgit lower at 4,219 ringgit a ton. (yingxian.wong@wsj.com)
